title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-03-24
lineage: SBD> MR> CASS> DAT> CDA> SHN> DAW(Bertha)> CDA/SHN

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard recording of a legendary 3/24/73 Spectrum show with soaring vocals, killer Dark Star/Spanish‑Jam sequence and standout performances throughout.
ai_review.review: The SBD (Betty board) capture is crystal‑clear, with balanced mix, bright vocals and Keith’s keyboards front‑and‑center – many reviewers call it “perfect sound.” Musically the concert shines: a blistering Dark Star/Spanish Jam suite, fiery Truckin', an inspired Play‑in‑the‑Band, Row Jimmy and heartfelt Here Comes Sunshine make this one of ’73’s top shows. Overall the crowd‑energy, tight interplay and extended jams earn universal praise.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 60 reviews (mostly 5 stars) consistently highlight both superb soundboard quality and exceptional musical performance, with only a few minor criticisms.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Betty board remastered by Jay Ashley; crystal‑clear mix, vocals shine, Keith’s keys prominent, balanced left/right placement of Bob and Jerry. No significant drop‑outs or noise reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fluid, syncopated set with a powerful first half and an explosive second‑set jam suite (He’s Gone → Truckin' → Jam → Space → Dark Star → Sing Me Back Home). Reviewers note the show’s length, energy and seamless transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals praised as among his best; guitar tone and solos on Dark Star, Play‑in‑the‑Band and Truckin' described as “on fire.”
band_member_comments.Phil: Harmony vocals highlighted (Box of Rain, Here Comes Sunshine); mix places him prominently in the front.
band_member_comments.Bob: Lead vocal praised on several songs; rhythm guitar noted for solid timing, occasional goofs but overall strong.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s organ/keys described as “crushing,” central to jams; Ron McKernan’s legacy mentioned positively.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming called “solid,” “perfect time” and a key driver of the extended jams.
